```python
def get_basic_announcements(announcements: List[Dict[str, Any]],
    include_local: bool=True) ->List[Dict[str, Any]]:
    basic_announcements = [
        announcement for announcement in announcements
        if announcement.get('type', '').lower() != 'primary_announcement'
    ]
    
    if include_local:
        local_announcements = SafetyContext().local_announcements
        if local_announcements:
            basic_announcements = list(local_announcements) + basic_announcements
    
    return basic_announcements
```
